select
from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.del_flag = 0
u.del_flag = 0
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{query.nickName}, '%')
and u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{query.phonenumber}, '%')
and u.status = #{query.status}
and ( u.dept_id = #{query.deptId} or u.dept_id in ( select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.del_flag = 0 and concat(',', sd.ancestors, ',') like concat('%,', #{query.deptId}, ',%') ) )
